title: Inventory real logs for VLA dry-run conversion
objective: Create a safe inventory of real log/report artifacts that could later be converted into VLA dry-run JSONL events.
context: task_0006 and task_0007 proved that the static VLA dry-run validator can pass valid fixtures and reject invalid fixtures. The next step is to identify real project logs/artifacts that contain task phase, robot state, safety gate, action, media, localization, or success/failure signals for future conversion.
steps: Validate this task with agent_guard.py before doing anything else.
Read this task JSON and the declared read_only_files.
Run the declared find command to list candidate text log/report artifacts under logs/ and rack_hybrid_docking_package/logs/.
Inspect the candidate list and, if needed, read only small text candidates from the declared read_only_dirs using file-read capability, not undeclared shell commands.
Do not read binary files, datasets, checkpoints, rosbags, secrets, or robot control scripts.
The inventory must classify candidate artifacts by usefulness for VLA dry-run conversion: high, medium, low, or unknown.

For high-value candidates, identify what signals may be extractable: task_phase, success_label, safety_gate, robot_state, localization_state, media_state, action_family, action_vector, critic_category, artifact_refs.
Recommend the single safest next task for real log to JSONL conversion.
Run the declared result_checker.py command after writing the result JSON.
Do not modify source code outside .ai_agents.
commands: find logs rack_hybrid_docking_package/logs -maxdepth 3 -type f \( -name '*.log' -o -name '*.json' -o -name '*.jsonl' -o -name '*.md' -o -name '*.txt' \) -size -2M | sort | head -200 > .ai_agents/review/real_log_candidates.txt
success_criteria: The inventory classifies candidate logs/reports by usefulness for VLA dry-run conversion.
The inventory identifies extractable signals for high-value candidates.
The inventory recommends one concrete low-risk task_0009 for converting a small selected real log sample into VLA dry-run JSONL.
No robot motion script, ROS driver, controller, dataset, checkpoint, rosbag, or secret is accessed.
No source code outside .ai_agents is modified.
stop_conditions: Any command attempts to launch a robot, ROS, controller, or motion script.
Any command attempts to modify source code outside .ai_agents.
Any command attempts to read secrets, datasets, checkpoints, or rosbags.
A command requires sudo or installs system packages.
A command attempts to start ROS drivers, hardware controllers, or actuator commands.
AI-B needs a shell command not listed in task.commands.
